about: What a run of bun_loop_slice may print on a host that is not Linux where expected/linux.jsonl has something else. compare-run.ts reads this file. A step is named as in the output.

host.why: the host, and the code that the image takes for it

timer of uSockets.why: bun has a timer of uSockets on Windows only (bun_uws_sys::Timer). It is the last line.

not_run.win32: Nothing of this program has run on Windows when this file was written. The lines of the steps are expected to be the ones of Linux: a child that uv_process_kill ended is Signaled for bun (src/spawn/process.rs, on_exit_uv), and 16 MiB do not pass a loopback socket in one write on either system. The program has one step more on Windows, the timer of uSockets, at the end. A line that differs is a finding, not an accepted difference.
